items.title: Joseph "Fan" Bourgeau Interview, 1972-09-13
items.q: The name 'Conor' appears only in the interviewer's question 'Did you run out of tape, Conor?', referring to the interviewer, not the interviewee's subject.

ctx.x: No, he had a ballroom. He used to call me to play the piano for them. He was like a tunk, you know. He'd dance and that shit.
Did you run out of tape, Conor?
Yeah. And what I still have, I want to say for Simon. Yeah, sure.
